name: Wicked Lawless Love
source: Notoriety in the big cities has you on the run, as you head for the lawless Sono Territory, home of the Devil’s Backbone. The line between good and evil blurs when you’re swept up into the business of monsters and devils. Will you fall victim to creatures of the night, or will you ride off into the sunset with your supernatural suitor?
